caption: Site Zone
description: The Site Zone object describes a site zone: a defined area within a physical site that shares a common security posture, such as a perimeter, a public lobby, or a restricted area. It is distinct from the zone attribute, which describes a network zone.
name: site_zone

type_id.description: The normalized classification of the site zone by security posture. These are generic tiers by security posture. Regime-specific tiers map onto them rather than extending the list: for example, a controlled, limited, or protected area maps to Restricted, and an exclusion, vital, or material access area maps to Critical. Carry the native tier name in type.

references.description: DoD 5200.08-R, Physical Security Program: restricted areas (controlled, limited, exclusion)
10 CFR 73.2, NRC definitions: protected area, vital area, material access area

1.caption: Perimeter
1.description: The outer boundary of the site.

2.caption: Public
2.description: An area open to the public.

3.caption: Restricted
3.description: An area restricted to authorized persons.

5.caption: Transitional
5.description: A lobby, corridor, or other transitional space.

6.caption: External
6.description: An outdoor area within the site boundary.

99.caption: Other
99.description: The zone type is not mapped. See the type attribute, which contains a data source specific value.

type.description: The site zone type, normalized to the caption of the type_id value. In the case of 'Other', it is defined by the event source.
